name: Celani constantan Cu–Ni–Mn air-flow AHE (2019)
description: JCMNS 29 near-miss exploratory hydrate. Best air-flow result: AHE over 12 ± 2 W on 100 µm constantan (Cu55Ni44Mn1) wire in D2 at 1 bar, Pin 90 W; wire broke within ~1 day. Same-sentence ±2 W is method-indetermination / raw uncorrected air-flow class — not literature_reported total σ_Q. Stable 6–7 W (200 µm, Xe–D2) reported without ±. EMP contested; does not close EQ-OPEN-YIELD-01.
moe_notes: EXPLORATORY MoE only — not discovery-grade. Celani et al. JCMNS 29 (2019) DOI 10.70923/001c.72494 state AHE was over 12 ± 2 W (100 µm wire, D2 1 bar, Pin 90 W) in the same best-results sentence; body notes raw air-flow data without air-density corrections and heat-loss caveats; sibling JCMNS 19 method language is large indetermination usually ±1 W up to ±2 W. Wire-break fragility and MFMP calorimetry concerns apply. moe_sigma_q_pairing_verified stays false; moe_provenance is instrument_precision — refuse literature_reported discovery flip. Arithmetic S_heat=12/2=6 is gates-blocked. EQ-OPEN-YIELD-01 stays OPEN; lenr_proved stays false.

parameters.host_note: Constantan Cu55Ni44Mn1 wire; nickel-class host for lattice presets. Carbon-class cells are separate.

honest_closure.honesty: Honest closure path for lenr_proved / EQ-OPEN-*. discovery_grade_eligible is an analytics flag only and never implies closure. Campaign / avenue / Lean outputs never set lenr_proved or close EQ-OPEN-*. Planned lenr-ara-daq-sample-v1 ingest stays non-attested and never discharges obligations. Planned DAQ occupancy/collective Nat pairs stay ineligible for EQ-OPEN-RATE-01 underwriting (EQ-RATE-DAQ-OCC-NC-01). Miles EMP / expected-yield bookkeeping without retention/collection efficiency provenance never closes EQ-OPEN-YIELD-01 (EQ-YIELD-EFF-NC-01). Bare detector γ UL without efficiency/geometry/heat-coincidence never closes EQ-OPEN-RAD-01 (EQ-RAD-EFF-NC-01). Named Hagelstein/Dicke/BEC labels without constrained matrix element + occupation never close EQ-OPEN-MEV-01 (EQ-MEV-LABEL-NC-01). UI gap-to-threshold cosmetics / Widom scaffold without independent measurement never close EQ-OPEN-EC-01 (EQ-EC-UI-NC-01).
